ui_bugs.issue: NO-OVERLAP requirement not met in preview: delayed GET /api/calls/active reached max_inflight=2 after login/Leads navigation, so a single poller can still have multiple concurrent requests pending.

A single Leads navigation started two identical GET /api/leads?bucket=pipeline&page=1&limit=50&sort=create_date&order=desc requests under stall conditions; both timed out around 60s and surfaced duplicate 'Server is busy' toasts. This still contributes to connection pressure, even though the timeout itself is bounded.

integration_issues.issue: Each of the four global poller endpoints fired twice immediately on protected layout mount in preview (/calls/active, /whatsapp/unread-summary, /leads/followups/reminders, /agent/me). Hidden-tab pause works after mount, but initial duplicate mount traffic remains.

action_items: Fix usePoll so in-flight state survives React StrictMode/effect remounts or otherwise globally de-dupes by poller key; delayed /api/calls/active must never exceed one in-flight request.
De-dupe Leads list loading on mount/navigation so a single Leads click cannot start duplicate identical GET /api/leads reads or duplicate busy toasts.
Re-run the 15s delayed /api/calls/active test and the stalled /api/leads 60s timeout test after the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/hooks/usePoll.js keeps inFlight as a local variable inside the effect. In React StrictMode/dev-style remounts, the first mount's immediate async tick remains pending after cleanup while the second mount starts another immediate tick, so no-overlap is not guaranteed across remounts.
frontend/src/pages/Leads.jsx load() useEffect can issue duplicate identical GET /api/leads in the preview runtime; there is no request-level de-dupe/in-flight guard for the page read.

success_rate.frontend: 4/6 focused checks passed; 2 critical checks failed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use https://ivf-lead-ops.preview.emergentagent.com as the browser origin (localhost + preview API hits CORS with credentials). Admin credentials worked. Browser evidence: no-overlap test saw /api/calls/active starts #1 and #2 before the first 15s-delayed response released (max_inflight=2). Hidden pause test saw no new poll requests over 35s hidden and resumed on visible. Auth bootstrap with stalled /auth/me fell back to login in ~51.4s, but route interception saw duplicate attempts per retry. GET timeout test saw friendly busy toast at ~60.1s, but two identical /api/leads list requests started and two toasts appeared.
rca_of_the_issue: Likely frontend StrictMode/effect remount duplication: usePoll's inFlight guard is scoped to a single effect instance, so it does not protect against the old immediate tick still pending while the remounted effect starts a new tick. Leads page similarly lacks in-flight/de-dupe around its initial list load. This means the user-visible 'many calls/pending connections' symptom is reduced but not fully eliminated.
